rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.0025, tv_iterations=1500, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-16 DEEP-CONVERGENCE at the peak lambda. ONE knob: tv_iterations 1000->1500 (keep gd, lambda=2.5e-3, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, fbp). HYPOTHESIS: if hr rises past 0.36286 the peak-lambda optimum was still marginally convergence-limited; if flat, 0.36286 is the firm plain-TV plateau on breast. Budget: iter-8 ~950s at 1000 -> ~1400s at 1500 (watch; <1800s job wall).
